title: Classic American Barramundi Casserole
description: A comforting and flavorful fish casserole that combines the sweetness of barramundi with the tanginess of cheese. It's perfect for a family dinner or a weekend meal.
instructions: Grease the casserole dish with butter.
Season the barramundi fillets with salt and black pepper.
Dredge the barramundi fillets in flour to coat.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and stir in 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese until melted.
Arrange half of the barramundi fillets in the prepared casserole dish.
Pour the cheese sauce over the fish.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese and American cheese slices.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
